candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is not supplied (as in email registration, which doesn't pass a provider), the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google instead of email. The new user is stored with provider 'google', so AuthService.validateLogin (provider !== email) rejects with 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google.
